parameters.name: DeviceListStr
parameters.description: The array of sub-devices to be mounted on the target gateway device. The value is a JSON string that contains the identity information of sub-devices. You can use **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** or **IotId** to identify a device. Example: **[{"productKey":"a1BwAGxxx","deviceName":"device1"},{"IotId":"Q7uOhxxx"}]**.

parameters.name: GwDeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name of the gateway device.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: GwIotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the gateway device. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identifier of the device.
> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: GwProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway device belongs.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
